name: Straight Talk Wireless
notes: Researched from public straighttalk.com pages and the support.straighttalk.com knowledge base (rendered with a headless browser; no sign-in, no refill submitted). Straight Talk (Verizon Value) is prepaid: plans are bought or refilled each service cycle and Auto Pay charges on the renewal (Service End) date. My Account sign-in takes a phone number, email, serial or SIM number, then Continue, then the password (loginSteps 2, identifier phone with a label naming the alternatives; the engine accepts the phone only). Password resets send a link by email or text. Refill Your Account works without signing in by entering the phone, serial or IMEI number (guestLookupFields [phone], guestLookupExact). Cards (including all debit cards) and bank accounts linked through Trustly are accepted, and Auto Pay can use either plus a backup method. Extended Pay moves the payment date forward 1-5 days for a flat $5 (non-premium) or $10 (Gold/Platinum) plus tax on eligible single-line accounts; it is a due-date change, not an installment plan, so payment_arrangement is not_applicable with a note (GAP: due-date extension cannot be modelled). No paper bills (paperless not_applicable, inferred), no future-dated payments (scheduled_payment not_applicable, inferred). There is no cancel step: service ends at the Service End Date when not refilled and the number can be reassigned (cancel_service not_applicable). Plans are the published one-line monthly prices without Auto Pay discounts. Reviewer (2026-10-10): the refill page and the My Account App payment FAQ also accept PayPal; the engine has no PayPal method, so it appears in help text only.

guest_pay.note: Refill Your Account without logging in: enter the phone number (or serial/IMEI) of the line, then pay for a plan or redeem a plan PIN.

autopay.note: Auto Pay enrolls every eligible line and charges your payment method on your payment date; a plan PIN in Reserve is used first. Add a backup method in case the default fails.

autopay_cancel.note: Turn off Auto Pay any time in Manage Auto Pay or the app, or call 1-877-430-2355. There is no fee, but any Auto Pay discount ends.

scheduled_payment.note: Refills are charged when you buy them; Auto Pay charges automatically on your payment date.

paperless.note: Straight Talk is prepaid and does not mail bills; your Transactions history is in My Account.

payment_arrangement.note: Payments cannot be split. Eligible single-line accounts can use Extended Pay to move the payment date 1-5 days for a flat $5 fee ($10 on Gold or Platinum Unlimited) plus tax.

cancel_service.note: No cancellation is needed: if you do not refill, service ends at your Service End Date and the number can be reassigned. Turn off Auto Pay to stop charges.

pay_by_mail.note: Straight Talk does not take mailed payments; refill online, in the app, by text to 611611, with a Service Plan Card from a retailer, or by calling 1-877-430-2355.

change_plan.note: Choose a new service plan when you refill; it applies to your next service cycle.

help.title: How does Auto Pay work?
paragraphs: Signing up for Auto Pay enrolls every eligible line, plan and perk on the account. Your chosen payment method is charged automatically on your payment date; if a plan PIN is waiting in your Reserve, it is applied first.
Most credit and debit cards work, and you can link a bank account through Trustly. Add a backup payment method in Manage Auto Pay; it is charged only if the default fails.
You can cancel Auto Pay any time online, in the app or by calling 1-877-430-2355. There is no cancellation fee, but an Auto Pay discount stops.

help.title: What is Extended Pay?
paragraphs: Extended Pay moves your payment date forward by 1 to 5 days for a flat fee, and the new date stays for all future cycles. It costs $10.00 plus tax on Gold and Platinum Unlimited and $5.00 plus tax on other plans, whatever the number of days.

It is for single-line phone accounts that have finished a full service cycle. It is not available for multi-month or non-30-day plans, home internet, lines with SmartPay financing or Straight Talk Protect, accounts with plans in Reserve or certain perks, suspended accounts, or twice in one cycle.

help.title: Refill your account
paragraphs: Refill online without logging in by entering the phone number, serial or IMEI of the line, then buying a plan with a credit or debit card (PayPal is also accepted) or redeeming a Service Plan PIN. Signed-in customers can pick the line from their account. If you stop refilling, Straight Talk stops paying the carrier for that line and the number can be reassigned; to reactivate you must add a service plan.

help.title: Straight Talk plans
paragraphs: One-line monthly prices: Bronze 10 GB $35, Silver Unlimited $45, Gold Unlimited $55 and Platinum Unlimited $65. Multi-month Silver and Gold plans and a $30 Basic Phone Plan are also sold. Auto Pay offers can lower the first months.
